title: The Hedgehog
phrases: a pointed snout and black nose

doing.t: is walking along with its nose down
is rolled up into a tight, prickly ball
is scratching behind one ear with a back foot
is sniffing at a fallen apple

close: Just the hedgehog, big enough to show single spines.
Only the hedgehog, side on, with no background.

roles.dark: for the nose, the eyes and the shadow underneath
roles.light: for the pale tips of the spines

firstMark: Start with the spines: short flicks of {main}, all pointing back the same way.
Start with the outline of the body: one rounded shape in a light line of {main}.

firstMark: Start with the curve of the back in a light line of {main}.
